name: 车辆保养项目周期排程表

map.输入当前里程，自动生成到期/超期/即将保养清单，支持记录完成与历史日志: Enter current mileage to generate due / overdue / upcoming maintenance lists automatically, with completion records and history logging
map.严苛工况（短途拥堵/多尘/重载）: Severe duty (short trips / dust / heavy load)
map.清单确认后点「记录本次保养完成」，当前里程与时间会写入浏览器本地存储，历史日志按: After confirming the list, click "Log this service as done" and the current mileage and time are written into browser local storage, with history listed newest first. Data stays in this browser only and is never uploaded; clearing browser data removes it as well.
map.各项目按「基准周期 × 工况系数」得实际周期，再按周期整倍数滚动定位下次到期里程: Each item uses "base interval × condition factor" as its real interval, then rolls forward in whole multiples to locate the next due mileage (e.g. a 10000 km interval with current mileage 52000 km gives 60000 km next). Anything below the lead distance counts as "upcoming" and anything past due as "overdue".
map.💡 本表为通用参考排程，不同车型手册差异较大，实际以随车保养手册与 4S 店记录: 💡 This is a generic reference schedule; manuals differ widely between models, so follow the vehicle manual and dealership records.
map.📚 深度解析：保养项目排程与阈值触发: 📚 In-depth: Maintenance Item Scheduling and Threshold Triggers
map.按每辆车的里程/日期阈值批量生成保养工单，均衡车间产能。: Generate maintenance work orders per vehicle in batches from mileage/date thresholds to level workshop capacity.
map.结合运营淡旺季错峰安排，避免集中停工影响运力。: Schedule around busy and quiet seasons so downtime does not cluster and hurt fleet availability.
map.追踪超期未保车辆并预警，保障合规与安全。: Track vehicles overdue for service and warn early, protecting compliance and safety.
map.按整倍数滚动定位下次到期里程: Locating the next due mileage by whole multiples
map.当前里程 52000 km、全合成机油周期 10000 km 时，下次到期里程取: With current mileage 52000 km and a full synthetic interval of 10000 km, the next due mileage is the 60000 km multiple, leaving 8000 km; the air filter and cabin filter at 15000 km also land on 60000 km, so they can join the same workshop visit as the oil change; the fuel filter (35000 km) falls at 70000 km and brake fluid (40000 km) at 80000 km. At 1500 km per month the remaining oil distance is about 5.3 months.
map.多阈值怎么合并排程？: How do I merge multiple thresholds into one schedule?
map.取里程与时间先到者触发，再把同车多项保养（机油+三滤+检查）合并一次施工，减少进: Trigger on whichever comes first, distance or time, then combine several jobs for the same vehicle (oil + three filters + inspection) into one visit to cut trips and labour.
map.如何避免保养挤在同一周？: How do I stop service clustering into one week?
map.按阈值到达顺序滚动排程并设每周上限，超量顺延，同时留缓冲应对突发维修。: Roll forward in the order thresholds are met and cap the weekly load, deferring the excess, while keeping slack for unexpected repairs.
map.各项目按「基准周期 × 工况系数」的整倍数滚动排程，实际以随车保养手册为准；记录: Items roll by whole multiples of "base interval × condition factor"; follow the vehicle manual in practice; records stay only in this browser
